market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $130 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI at ~$103, recent peak ~$109. To hit $130 in May requires ~26% from spot — would need a sharp escalation of the Hormuz crisis (e.g. military strikes, full closure). Historically such moves have happened in supply shocks but it's an above-recent-high target with ~1 month. Roughly 12-22%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether the Hormuz crisis escalates militarily or de-escalates via diplomacy.
